description: Add a form guide to the League Table showing each player's last 5 results as overlapping colored circles (W/D/L), sortable by form points.

userStories.title: Create utility to extract player's recent results
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a function that extracts a player's last N match results in chronological order so that form can be displayed and calculated.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `getPlayerRecentResults(playerName: string, rawData: RawPlayerData[], matches: Match[], count: number): ('W' | 'D' | 'L')[]` in `app/utils/formUtils.ts`
Returns array of results ordered oldest to newest (last element is most recent game)
Only includes matches where the player participated
Returns fewer than `count` results if player has played fewer games

userStories.title: Create utility to calculate form points
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a function to calculate form points from recent results so that the table can be sorted by form.
acceptanceCriteria: W = 3 points, D = 1 point, L = 0 points
Returns sum of points (max 15 for 5 games)
Handles arrays shorter than 5 (returns points for available games)

userStories.title: Create FormBadge component for single result circle
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable component that renders a single result as a colored circle with a letter.
acceptanceCriteria: Colors: W = green-500, D = wheat-500, L = red-500
White text letter centered in circle
Circle size appropriate for table row (h-6 w-6 on mobile, h-7 w-7 on lg)

userStories.title: Create FormDisplay component for overlapping circles
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my recent form as overlapping colored circles so that I can quickly see my run of results without taking too much table space.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders FormBadge for each result with negative margin overlap (e.g., -ml-2)
Results ordered left-to-right: oldest to newest
Empty array shows nothing or dash

userStories.title: Add form data to ProcessedPlayer type
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to extend the ProcessedPlayer type to include form data so it can be used in the LeagueTable.

userStories.title: Calculate form data in data processing
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to populate form data when processing raw data so that it's available to the LeagueTable.
acceptanceCriteria: Update `processRawData` in `app/lib/dataProcessing.ts` to calculate Form and FormPoints
Form is last 5 results (or fewer if player has less)

userStories.title: Add Form column to LeagueTable
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a Form column in the league table showing my recent results as colored circles.
acceptanceCriteria: Column header is sortable (clicking sorts by FormPoints)
Display FormDisplay component for each player
Column responsive (works on mobile and desktop)

userStories.title: Enable sorting by form in LeagueTable
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sort the league table by form so that I can see who is in the best/worst run of results.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Form header sorts by FormPoints descending (best form first)
Sort icon appears when Form is active sort column
